title: [Day 02] Session format and event types
text:
Part 5 of 5 is in. `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` now has a Session format section: the 12 event kinds, and an example session (meta, a snapshot, a click, a text mutation, and a network event).

`packages/shared/src/example-session.test.ts` loads that JSON fence and runs every event through `parseEvent`. The fence is the fixture so the doc and the parser stay in step. That choice is ADR 0009.

Checks on `09f0a79`: `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, and `pnpm build` all passed. This PR is ready for review.
